failures.evidence: No CI has ever run on this change, because the pull request conflicts with main. `gh pr view 2503 --repo sjawhar/legion --json headRefOid,mergeable,mergeStateStatus` at 13:00Z: {"headRefOid":"c1823f2959611c668b1ac29e5ddc3df893a343b9","mergeStateStatus":"DIRTY","mergeable":"CONFLICTING"}. `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only 14d907b6fdd3 c1823f2959611c668b1ac29e5ddc3df893a343b9` reports CONFLICT (content) in docs/kubernetes.md and auto-merges docs/deployment.md; the one conflicting hunk is main's 14d907b6 (merged 2026-10-29T12:58:09Z, three minutes after this pull request opened) rewriting 'Every role is told `LEGION_GH_OWNERS_DIR=…`' into 'Every role container is told …', the sentence this branch inserts its new paragraphs directly above. GitHub computes no merge ref for a conflicting head and starts no workflow run for it: `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/<sha>/check-runs --jq .total_count` is 0 for 682732a1, 14cd0def, b01d0dad and c1823f29, each with status `pending`, and `gh run list --repo sjawhar/legion --branch legion/INFRA-228` shows nothing newer than 2026-10-25 (PR #2187). So no code head carries a verdict for the handoff push to inherit either. No red test pins this: a merge conflict is not a behaviour a repository test can assert, and this deployment's instructions forbid a test that reads a workflow file and asserts things about its contents. The fix is a forward merge of main with that one hunk resolved (keep main's 'Every role container is told …' sentence and this branch's three new paragraphs above it), then a push that carries no skip-checks trailer, so CI runs. Once the unchanged-diff fingerprint at the new head equals the fingerprint at c1823f29, the real-surface verification in this handoff is not repeated: only the bare gates are.
